headline: Seduta in prevalenza negativa a Wall Street: Sandisk +8,88% guida i rialzi
headline_en: Broadly negative session on Wall Street: Sandisk +8.88% leads gainers

paragraphs: Nella seduta del 17 agosto 2026 l'S&P 500 ha chiuso con 133 societa' in rialzo, 368 in ribasso e 2 invariate, su 503 titoli monitorati. La variazione media dell'indice e' stata di -0,90%.

Settori con la variazione media migliore: Energy (+0,77%); Information Technology (-0,40%); Utilities (-0,42%). Settori piu' debolli: Consumer Staples (-1,79%); Communication Services (-1,72%); Consumer Discretionary (-1,67%).

In cima alla seduta: Sandisk (SNDK, +8,88%); Coherent Corp. (COHR, +7,79%); Comfort Systems USA (FIX, +6,04%). In fondo: Carvana (CVNA, -7,28%); Charter Communications (CHTR, -6,59%); Constellation Brands (STZ, -6,19%).

en: In the August 17, 2026 session the S&P 500 closed with 133 stocks higher, 368 lower and 2 unchanged, out of 503 tracked. The average move was -0.90%.

Best-performing sectors by average move: Energy (+0.77%); Information Technology (-0.40%); Utilities (-0.42%). Weakest: Consumer Staples (-1.79%); Communication Services (-1.72%); Consumer Discretionary (-1.67%).

Leading the session: Sandisk (SNDK, +8.88%); Coherent Corp. (COHR, +7.79%); Comfort Systems USA (FIX, +6.04%). At the bottom: Carvana (CVNA, -7.28%); Charter Communications (CHTR, -6.59%); Constellation Brands (STZ, -6.19%).
